notes.title: Roc Game Fest Update - New Detected Level and Controller Support
notes.notes:
Hey CyberSurfers, Roc Game Fest was a great time! We learned so much from everyone and thank you for stopping by!
[h2]Updated Detected Level[/h2][list]
[*] We've removed two levels, but updated one level to use our new level generation system allowing us to create more dynamic and fun levels. The idea of CyberSurfer is to move throughout space and time, meaning we want our players to move fast and have more variety than previous levels. We hope you like it and please give us feedback in our playtest form or discord. It really helps us find out what works and what doesn't. Don't get detected...
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43979241/7f7606ecd1d9782fcf322a10a91e660ecf8d0b69.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43979241/325e162dfeccf9ded47a62a7fc6ded88d33aad0f.gif[/img][h2]Controller Support![/h2][list]
[*] To extend the reach of CyberSurfer and give existing players more ways to play. We added controller support, specially DualSense controllers (PS4/PS5). You control the hoverboard the exact same way and regular controller input works to perform abilities. If you got a controller, check it out and lets us know how it feels! (We recommend connecting your controller through USB)
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43979241/27a0be24c1c8c35b62acdacdbdbada3b42da509b.gif[/img]
[h2]New Art Style[/h2]
[list]
[*] The old art style was okay, but it could be a lot better. We decided on cel-shading and object outlines to really bring out objects, and still give use the opportunity to create more intricate and dynamic levels. 
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43979241/5f6ee286a48b6bed8b291ed268fcd3496372bdc1.gif[/img]
[h2]Cast To Game Menu[/h2][list]
[*] When you open the game, you will now see a simple Cast to Game Menu. It helps players understand the startup connection process, before the main menu. We want all players to understand how to use the game and now get lost before they enjoy the game. 
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43979241/820ef6940fc489ed50c3b234993c65284938b330.gif[/img]
[h2]Other Patch Notes:[/h2][list]
[*] End of Level Results for the Tutorial level and Local Leaderboard for the Detected level will be displayed
[*] We removed Simulation and CyberCity to revamp our system, but feel confident we can start adding more levels very soon!
[*] Revamped the Settings Menu, and it explains input/controls much better
[*] The game now has a straight forward Tutorial that explains basic movement and abilities
[*] Rotating the hoverboard feels much smoother (Movement Update)
[*] CyberPhone (Phone App) UI now has a How To Play Menu
[/list]

notes.title: Horizontal Controller Update
notes.notes:
[h2] CyberSurfer Playtest Update v.006
[/h2]

What's New:
[list]
[*] Added Horizontal Orientation for Phone App
[*] Added multiple controller orientations (0°, 45°, 90°)
[*] Update Player Movement with more fluid rotations
[*] Added Controller Orientation Menu (Accessible through Settings Menu)
[/list]
[h2]Vertical Orientation[/h2]
This is the vertical orientation for the phone app. The vertical orientation is the starting orientation for the phone app. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43979241/379af41ea957336072113659e8b46ecc62aa3538.png[/img]
[h2]Horizontal Orientation[/h2]
This is the horizontal orientationfor the phone app. We got a lot of feedback asking for a orientation akined to Mario Kart or a driving wheel. So here you go!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43979241/25bfb0448493e5e3f04fcd43c143649da6065ae5.png[/img]
[h2]Change Controller Orientation in Phone App[/h2]
Enable the Phone App Options Screen by holding two fingers on the screen until a blue screen appears. Disable the checkbox to orient your phone in the horizontal position. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43979241/05386e6ada90f00b8687a51900fb1e7a7c566d6e.png[/img]
[h2]Controller Orientation Menu[/h2]
You can now select your starting angle more effectively and understand the rotations of your phone. Go to the settings menu in the Main or Pause menu and select "Change Board Orientation".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43979241/43dc802bf27f655a539cbced533db91231fabad2.png[/img]

notes.title: CyberSurfer Early Alpha Playtest!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43881431/53da7f4fab4f6cf59eadd56cd655d236ed70175a.png[/img]

Hey CyberSurfers,

We are SO EXCITED to release our playtest version of CyberSurfer on Steam! Using your mobile phone as the game controller, we need all the feedback we can get to create an intuitive controller for your all! 

At this stage of development, we want to focus on stable connectivity, user input, and hoverboard movement. So, please give us any suggestions, comments, and concerns to better the CyberSurfer experience. Our team has been working diligently our playtest version of the game, and we are eager to have you try it out.

[b]For those who have received access to the Steam Playtest, follow these steps to get started:
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43979241/0f81c642de23556316251ecc9c17e22df1a42239.gif[/img]
[h3]Download the Cybersurfer Mobile App from your respective app store:
[/h3]Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cybersurferllc.cyberphone

iOS: https://testflight.apple.com/join/l20KxOmz


You should have instant access to the mobile app after following the required steps from either App Store. (We are working on releasing the public versions of our mobile app for a smoother setup process.)

[h3]How do I play the game?
[/h3]
1. Open CyberSurfer the Game on Steam
2. Open the CyberSurfer Mobile App
3. Input the Game Code (Bottom-Left Corner) from CyberSurfer the Game into the CyberSurfer Mobile App
4. Press the "Connect" button on the CyberSurfer Mobile App
5. You are now able to control the virtual hoverboard

[h3]Playtest Feedback
[/h3]We encourage you to join our Discord community to share your thoughts, feedback, and connect with fellow players: https://discord.gg/F6sE58XaRB


Complete our Playtest Form to help us improve the game based on your experience: https://forms.gle/vDAQTJgsQdWErRrU6


[url=calebvaccaro@cybersurferllc.com]Contact us[/url], if you have any direct questions!

Thank you for your participation, and we look forward to your feedback.

Better Fly Fast,
The CyberSurfer Team
